Step 1: Midi Prep of plasmid - Qiagen Midi Prep Kit P508 T7-Cas9-nos-3'UTR

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 100 mL LB (or suitable medium) with the plasmid‑bearing strain and grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Isolate plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a midi‑prep of the overnight culture and elute the purified plasmid in 80 µL Elution Buffer (or water) – using 80‑100 µL yields a higher‑concentration stock than the standard 200 µL.

steps.title: Optional high‑conc elution
steps.instruction: If an even higher concentration is needed, elute the midi‑prep in 12‑15 µL Elution Buffer (EB).

steps.title: Set up restriction digest
steps.instruction: In a 200 µL total volume mix the following: water (add to bring volume to 200 µL), 20 µL CutSmart Buffer, 16 µL EcoRI‑HF, ~16 µg plasmid DNA. Split the mix into four PCR tubes (50 µL each).

steps.title: Digest plasmid
steps.instruction: Incubate the four tubes overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Verify digestion
steps.instruction: Run a 1 % agarose gel with a 1 kb ladder: Lane 1 ladder, Lane 2 1 µL uncut plasmid, Lane 3 1 µL linearized plasmid from reaction 1, Lane 4 1 µL linearized plasmid from reaction 2. Confirm complete digestion.

steps.title: Decontaminate work area
steps.instruction: Wipe bench and pipettes with RNase‑Away or RNAzap before handling RNA.

steps.title: Prepare transcription master mix
steps.instruction: For four reactions combine: 40 µL nuclease‑free water, 8 µL 2× NTP/ARCA, the volume of 10× Reaction Buffer recommended by the kit, 8 µL linear DNA (3.6–4.8 µg, 3 600–4 800 ng), and 80 µL T7 Enzyme Mix. Mix and quick‑spin.

steps.title: Start in‑vitro transcription
steps.instruction: Split the master mix into four PCR tubes and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h with lids open (do not close lids during incubation).

steps.title: Add Turbo DNase I
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 µL Turbo DNase I to each tube and incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare A‑tailing master mix
steps.instruction: While DNase I is incubating, make a master mix for four reactions: 145 µL nuclease‑free water, 80 µL 5× E‑PAP Buffer, 40 µL 25 mM MnCl₂, 40 µL ATP solution (add an extra 1 µL water to allow equal distribution).

steps.title: Optional pre‑A‑tailing Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Take 1.5 µL from each transcription tube, pool tubes 1‑2 and 3‑4 separately, and set aside as a control before A‑tailing.

steps.title: Add E‑PAP enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL E‑PAP enzyme to each tube and mix gently.

steps.title: A‑tailing incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 37 °C for 45 min, then place on ice.

steps.title: Optional post‑A‑tailing Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Take 1.5 µL from each tube, pool tubes 1‑2 and 3‑4, and set aside as a control after A‑tailing.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction by adding 50 µL LiCl precipitation solution to each tube.

steps.title: Pool reactions
steps.instruction: Combine tubes 1‑2 into one 1.5 mL tube and tubes 3‑4 into a second 1.5 mL tube; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Pre‑chill a centrifuge to 2‑4 °C and centrifuge the pooled tubes at maximum speed for 30‑45 min to pellet the RNA.

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: While centrifuging, make 2 mL of 70 % ethanol using 200‑proof ACS ethanol.

steps.title: Keep one tube cold
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, leave one pooled tube in the chilled centrifuge (2‑4 °C) while processing the other tube through steps 17‑21.

steps.title: Inspect RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Verify a visible white pellet of sufficient size (approximately the size of a small “O” or larger).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette off the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet
steps.instruction: Add ~1 mL 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge again, then discard the ethanol wash.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL Elution Solution from the MEGAclear™ Transcription Clean‑Up Kit; vortex or pipette up‑and‑down until the pellet is fully dissolved and the solution is translucent.

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Binding Solution to the 100 µL eluate, mix well, then add 250 µL 100 % ethanol and mix again.

steps.title: Load spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the 700 µL mixture to a MEGAclear spin column, spin for 15 s, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with 500 µL Wash Solution, spinning 15 s each time and discarding the flow‑through.

steps.title: Remove residual wash
steps.instruction: Spin the column for an additional 1 min to eliminate any remaining wash solution.

steps.title: Elute RNA – first
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new collection tube, add 20 µL nuclease‑free water, close the tube, incubate at 65‑70 °C for 5‑10 min, then spin for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA – second
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution with another 20 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate at 65‑70 °C for 5 min, and spin to collect the second eluate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration with a Qubit™ RNA Broad Range (BR) Assay Kit (catalog Q10210); aim for >500 ng/µL for embryo injection.

steps.title: Optional Bioanalyzer analysis
steps.instruction: Take 3 µL of the purified RNA, combine with ~2 µL RNA ladder, heat at 90 °C for 2 min, then load onto a Bioanalyzer chip.

steps.title: Store linearized DNA
steps.instruction: Any unused linearized plasmid can be stored at 4 °C for several months; if re‑using, run a confirming gel to ensure the DNA remains linearized.
